ParentQuotaId.title:
Parent QuotaId  
1. If ParentQuotaId is empty, a root quota is created, and machines are assigned from a dedicated resource group.  
2. If ParentQuotaId is not empty, a child quota is created, and resources are assigned from the nodes attached to the root quota.
ParentQuotaId.description:
The ID of the parent quota.

- If this parameter is left empty, a root quota is created and machines are allocated from the dedicated resource group.

- If a parent quota ID is specified, a child quota is created and resources are allocated from the nodes that are attached to the parent quota.

ResourceGroupIds.description:
The list of dedicated resource groups. Note the following constraints:

- Only root quotas, for which ParentQuotaId is empty, can have machines allocated from resource groups.

- The VPC configurations of the specified resource groups must be consistent.
ResourceGroupIds.title:
List of Dedicated Resource Groups  
Constraints:  
1. Only the root quota (with an empty ParentQuotaId) can allocate resources from resource groups.  
2. The VPC configurations of all specified resource groups must be consistent.

AllocateStrategy.title: Quota Allocation Strategy (Currently, only ByNodeSpecs is supported)
AllocateStrategy.description: The allocation policy for the quota. Currently, only ByNodeSpecs is supported.

Min.description:
The configuration of the minimum quota. It includes:

- ResourceAmount: Specifies the CPU, memory, and GPU details.

- NodeSpecs: Specifies the machine specifications and quantity.

Constraints:

- If the quota allocates resources from a dedicated resource group, only the NodeSpec policy is allowed.

- If the quota allocates resources from a parent quota, both allocation policies are allowed. However, all child quotas must use the same allocation policy.

- All GPU specifications within the quota must be of the same card type.

- Resource quotas with the resource type set to ECS or Lingjun can only use the NodeSpecs method.

QuotaConfig.description:
Constraints on the QuotaConfig parameter:

- This configuration does not take effect if the resource type is ECS or Lingjun.

- If the resource type is ACS, the user's VPC information and ACS configuration take effect.

QueueStrategy.description:
Four queuing policies are supported for the quota.

- PaiStrategyIntelligent: The intelligent policy.

- PaiStrategyBalance: The balanced policy.

- PaiStrategyRoundRobin: The resource-first policy.

- PaiStrategyStrictFIFO: The first-in, first-out (FIFO) policy.
